What the Role Entails
About WorkSolo
WorkSolo is a professional creation tool built for AI creators. It empowers independent creators, studios, and creative professionals with AI-native workflows to ideate, produce, and publish high-quality content — from concept to final output. As we scale internationally, we're looking for a seasoned product manager to shape WorkSolo's product vision, roadmap, and creator experience for global markets.Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Own the product strategy and roadmap for WorkSolo's overseas markets, aligning HQ vision with local creator needs
Define product North Star metrics and success criteria (activation, retention, creation depth, publish-through rate, monetization)
Translate market insights, competitive intelligence, and creator behavior trends into prioritized product bets
AI-Native Feature Design
Lead end-to-end product design for AI creation workflows — covering ideation, generation, editing, collaboration, and publishing
Define and ship features around multimodal generation (text-to-image, text-to-video, voice, 3D), agentic workflows, asset management, and creator monetization
Partner with AI/ML, design, and engineering teams to ship high-quality experiences at startup speed
User Research & Market Insight
Build a continuous discovery system: creator interviews, usability studies, community listening, and quantitative analysis
Synthesize insights from Discord, Reddit, X/Twitter, YouTube, and TikTok creator ecosystems into product requirements
Develop deep personas for AI creators (independents, studios, professional creatives) and map their end-to-end workflows
Localization & Market Fit
Drive product localization strategy across language, payment, content policy, and creator economics for key markets (North America, EU, JP/KR, SEA, LATAM)
Define market-specific feature variants, onboarding flows, and pricing/packaging in collaboration with operations and growth
Champion the international user's voice within HQ; influence the global product roadmap with regional priorities
Data & Experimentation
Build a rigorous experimentation culture: hypothesis → A/B test → learning loops
Define instrumentation requirements and partner with data teams on dashboards, funnels, and cohort analysis
Use analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, etc.) to monitor product health and identify growth levers
AIGC Ecosystem & Partnerships
Stay at the forefront of the global AI creator tools ecosystem (workflows, toolchains, emerging models, and creator behavior trends)
Identify integration and partnership opportunities with model providers, distribution platforms, and creator ecosystems
Represent WorkSolo at industry events, creator conferences, and AIGC community gatherings
Cross-Functional Leadership
Lead cross-functional squads of engineers, designers, researchers, and data scientists across HQ (China) and LA
Own clear written PRDs, specs, and trade-off rationales; drive alignment across time zones
Collaborate closely with overseas operations, marketing, and BD to ensure go-to-market readiness

Who We Look For
Qualifications5–8 years of product management experience, ideally within creator tools, AIGC platforms, content/media, or developer-facing creative products
Proven track record shipping consumer or prosumer products at scale in international markets
Deep familiarity with the global AI creator tools landscape — including generation tools (Midjourney, Runway, Pika, Kling, Sora), creation workflow tools (Notion AI, Canva AI, Adobe Firefly, CapCut), and creator platform ecosystems (YouTube Studio, TikTok Creator Marketplace, Patreon, Substack)
Hands-on experience designing AI-native features (prompting UX, multimodal generation, agentic workflows, model orchestration) is strongly preferred
Strong data literacy; comfortable defining metrics, designing experiments, and using analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, SQL)
Experience operating across Western social platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, X) and understanding how AI creators discover, adopt, and evangelize creation tools
Excellent written and verbal English communication; Mandarin Chinese is a strong plus for HQ collaboration
Self-starter with startup mentality; comfortable operating with ambiguity, time-zone span, and the speed of an early-stage international expansion
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Design, HCI, Media, or a related field; equivalent practical experience welcome
Nice to HavePrior experience launching products from 0 → 1 in overseas markets
Personal creator background or active participation in AIGC creator communities
Familiarity with creator monetization models (subscriptions, marketplaces, revenue share, tipping)
Experience working across China–US dual-HQ structures
